user.title: Home Climate Control
user.description: Connect a **Home Climate System** device (ESP32/ESP8266 with HCS firmware), or pick **Demo** to explore without hardware.

demo.title: Demo
demo.description: Creates a simulated boiler with outdoor temperature, flame/modulation, and two rooms (Living Room + Bedroom). No MQTT or hardware required. Open the **Home Climate** sidebar after setup.

zone.title: Add a heating zone
zone.description: Zones already added: {zone_count}. Each zone needs a room temperature sensor. Optional TRVs are respected as demand sources; optional window sensors pause the zone when open.

data.name: Zone name
data.add_another: Add another zone after this one

discovery.title: New Home Climate System device found
discovery.description: Board **{node}** announced itself on MQTT. Confirm to adopt it — zones are configured on the next screen.
